function.description: Return the best observed trial; request configuration columns only as needed, or export one row to a scratch JSON file without printing it.
function.name: get_incumbent

include_config.description: Return the full configuration when parameter_names is omitted; default false.

max_chars.description: Response character budget, default 24000. Use output_path for larger configurations.

output_path.description: Export only the best selected row to scratch/*.json (items array, empty if no incumbent). Omit max_chars.

parameter_names.description: Return only these configuration columns; takes precedence over include_config.

function.description: Find parameter names or retrieve exact definitions; default is a paged index.
function.name: get_search_space

cursor.description: Use the exact returned next_cursor, with the same query.

limit.description: Upper bound on rows; max_chars may return fewer.

max_chars.description: Page character budget, default 6000. Follow next_cursor until null.

function.description: Read a named section of task details with pagination.
function.name: get_task_context

cursor.description: Use the exact returned next_cursor, with the same query.

limit.description: Upper bound on rows; max_chars may return fewer.

max_chars.description: Page character budget, default 6000. Follow next_cursor until null.

function.description: Read observed scores with pagination; mode=all still returns a page. Follow next_cursor, or export all selected rows to a scratch JSON file with output_path. Default is 5 recent trials; after_trial_id gives incremental feedback.
function.name: get_trial_history

cursor.description: Use the exact returned next_cursor, with the same query.

include_config.description: Return the full configuration when parameter_names is omitted; default false.

limit.description: Upper bound on rows; max_chars may return fewer.

max_chars.description: Page character budget, default 6000. Follow next_cursor until null.

output_path.description: Export all selected rows to scratch/*.json, without printing rows. Omit pagination arguments.

parameter_names.description: Return only these configuration columns; takes precedence over include_config.

function.description: Validate, commit and end this round in one call. Choose config, workspace JSON path, base_trial_id plus changes, or a saved candidate_id. Idempotent; host evaluates afterward.
function.name: submit_candidate

function.description: Optional: validate and save a draft, without submitting. Direct submit_candidate does not require this step.
function.name: write_candidate
